Astral Codex Ten analysis of the Gervais principle. Some highlighted pieces:
> Rao is trying to make the point that all associations require some level of status illegibility. ... the same social conspiracy that keeps people convinced they have useful talents, also keeps status illegible. This takes the form of everyone teasing each other, creating a constant churn of minor status increases and decrements which is too complicated for anyone to track properly.
> Sociopathy ... is about recognizing that there are no social realities.
> All that is required is to control people who believe in fairness, is to remove any evidence suggesting that the world might fundamentally not be a fair place, and mask it appropriately with a justice principle such as an afterlife calculus, or a retirement fantasy.
